tableView.comment: A table, chart or map view of a published table, shown on the public publication page

tableView.title: Table view
tableView.summary: A table, chart or map of a published table
tableView.description: How a published table is shown on the public publication page: a table of chosen columns, a bar or line chart of one column against another, or a map of points from a latitude and a longitude column (dataset-views-on-the-public-page REQ-DSV-001). Readers never read this object directly; the public view endpoints answer its data while the publication is public.

table.title: Table
table.description: The published table this view shows.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: How the view is drawn: table, bar, line or map.

title.title: Title
title.description: The heading readers see above the view.

columns.title: Columns
columns.description: For a table view: the columns shown, in order.

x.title: Horizontal axis
x.description: For a bar or line chart: the column on the horizontal axis.

y.title: Value column
y.description: For a bar or line chart: the column summed or averaged. Empty counts the rows.

aggregate.title: Aggregate
aggregate.description: For a bar or line chart: count the rows, or sum or average the value column.

latitude.title: Latitude column
latitude.description: For a map: the column holding the latitude (WGS84).

longitude.title: Longitude column
longitude.description: For a map: the column holding the longitude (WGS84).

label.title: Marker label
label.description: For a map: the column shown on a marker.

position.title: Position
position.description: The order of the view on the page, lowest first.
